notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content: With update 2.1 you can now choose two characters with a single control in training mode ... incredible but it took us 6 years to add that. Sorry.

Thanks!

notes.title: Combate Monero 1.9 Update
notes.content:
Fatima and Tetsuko join the fight!

Two new fighters are coming to Combat Monero in this long overdue update.

Tetsuko Kiyama is a classic Japanese schoolgirl who is not only a fervent admirer and practitioner of martial arts, but also a powerful psychomancer who must fight to save the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/8fe0d3a1584a4dc19e3d56a8dbdbc2d0684ea6e2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/7e9a6ba287987b713f59d221e5c222136824edfc.jpg[/img]

created by Arturo "Lobo" Vázquez & Enrique "La Bruja" Robledo, you can read more [url=http://campeonesjusticieros.blogspot.com/2016/09/tetsuko.html]here[/url]

Fatima is a reborn, someone who survived the infection and fights in a post-apocalyptic world against hordes of zombies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/ab7c38f4c6729b4b15c813ca9da39d7dc5c332db.jpg[/img]

You can find more information about Fatima[url=http://campeonesjusticieros.blogspot.com/2017/05/fatima.html]here[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.8 adds new Fighters!
notes.content:
Jose Luis, Enemy of the supernatural of Sergio Rios and Xiuhcoatl the fire serpent of Fernando García Rosales are in the Combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/0c1be12d3e8c455b9e54e2e5d7d0d82d4208a2c1.jpg[/img]


Jose Luis displays an indirect style of combat, invoking monsters and spirits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/ba13213b75802cf2c2a6f47cc85e340e3468c3db.jpg[/img]


While Xiuhcoatl goes straight to the point with an aggressive and fast style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/049efaa69bb45f887de24df59e95741af0b68dae.jpg[/img]


Curiously, it is not the first time that they meet, and right now they are sharing credits in a crossover comic !!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/d0c6e1fd89a36c601175dc5e6ec144349ec633cb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/ff2e7df125b62f52eafb648756ac5cf9ab76af62.jpg[/img]


You can read more about this crossover in this links! (spanish only)

[url=https://www.facebook.com/pg/joseluisenemigodelosobrenatural/photos/?tab=album&album_id=1259346677592367&ref=page_internal]Primer parte[/url]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/pg/joseluisenemigodelosobrenatural/photos/?tab=album&album_id=1275186522675049&ref=page_internal]Segunda Parte[/url]

notes.title: Two New Characters enter the roster... soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Two New characters enter the Ring! El Monito and Pepe[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/73d6e700ef3d633f7422ad5efdb8e760607c1cef.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/6b11989e2c92ff30effaebad3052d95eaeaae5a5.jpg[/img]

Pepe comes from the "Nahualo" WEBCOMIC by Daniel Garza Ledesma y Juan Manuel Colín Monroy, who publishes it on facebook.

He can morph into 4 animals or a super nahual mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/6a26527a1a1d9604db66758bbe79f1fbedad1395.jpg[/img]

El Monito was created by Rubén Armenta and is the self proclaimed WORST comic book character in the world, still, he roams the multiverse looking for fame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/0970be4f6bd8b33094cba0566f387e589fd8d7ac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/3d5b0a4b81d7586fc177fa39f125324652cd192c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/0c5b4a65460351c8319927605c9e825246c7080b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/21dbe1bd9aa5da6ca0501a1415b8c76488c2122b.jpg[/img]

Both characters will be available in the next update!

Happy Halloween and Dia de Muertos!
